title: Linear hitting-time variance for random clause size at least four
exact_target: For each fixed $k\geq 4$, let $H_n$ be the first unsatisfiable time under independent proper uniformly signed k-clauses sampled with replacement. Is $Var(H_n)=Theta_k(n)$? Ask also $Var(min(H_n,floor(Bn)))=Theta_{k,B}(n)$ for $B>\log (2)/(-\log (1-2^{-k}))$.
